profession.name: Blacksmithing
profession.summary: Blacksmiths bring a Sharpening Wheel to camp at skill 20, which raises Strength in the beta client (the Deep Dive said Attack Power), then an Anvil and a Master Forge. No Blacksmithing bonus has been shown.
